4488-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a 4/4 green Beast creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2105-3499-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1479-2841-6926-7705.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6926-7705.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2105-4247-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4247-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3121-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

874-2866-4986-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-4986-8095.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

618-2511-3817.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

676-1987-2556.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-2556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-2556.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-2556.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

190-643-4219.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Maskwood Nexus and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Because each opponent controls a Maskwood Nexus, their creatures are all Slivers and cannot attack due to having defender, which is granted by Dormant Sliver.

997-4986-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
997-4986-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

7-4659-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-4659-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying at most {2} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

3497-4907-5686-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
3497-4907-5686-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2511-3755-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2511-3755-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1469-1530.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
You are the monarch.
1469-1530.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance and Court of Vantress trigger.
Resolve the Court of Vantress trigger, creating a token copy of Second Chance.
Resolve the Second Chance trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2464-3459-5078-6918.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3459-5078-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

483-4681-5170-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-3363-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1170-3363-5078-7010.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

252-4871-6968.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-6968.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

471-5779.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
471-5779.description:
During any turn, activate Pestilence Demon by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Each creature your opponents control dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat each turn as desired.
471-5779.notes: This lock can be repeated multiple times during a single turn if you have mana available. However, this damage also stacks on your creatures - and if Maha dies then the lock ends. This lock will also destroy any creatures you control with toughness 1. As it does 1 damage to each player every time you activate it, you must stop once your life total hits 1.

3490-3698-4871-6829.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
3490-3698-4871-6829.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Venom and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Venom trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1308-1563-2457-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

586-997-5258-5618-6556.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

339-1636-2011.easyPrerequisites: You control a Warrior that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
339-1636-2011.description:
Declare a Warrior you control as an attacker, triggering Najeela, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
When the Warrior enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1789-2232-6440--94.description:
Cast the Dragon in your hand without paying its mana cost.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers if the Dragon isn't an artifact and Lathliss triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, if applicable, choosing to return nothing.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the Dragon cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1115-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

851-1308-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

1558-5736.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five in any combination of Assassins, Pirates and/or Vehicles.
You are able to tap at least five Assassins, Pirates and/or Vehicles you control each turn.
1558-5736.description:
Tap at least five Assassins, Pirates and/or Vehicles you control, either by declaring them as attackers if they don't have vigilance or by using any other method.
At the beginning of your end step, Edward Kenway's first ability triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch // Temple of Cyclical Time

5231-5550-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
5231-5550-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Lazotep Convert, adding {R}.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-5003-5359.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk, adding {C}{C}.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Threefold Thunderhulk from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating at least five creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

711-3525-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle and Pemmin's Aura attached to Fallowsage.
Fallowsage does not have summoning sickness.
711-3525-4474.description:
Activate Fallowsage by tapping it, adding {U}.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1283-2034-3996.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1283-2034-3996.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {3} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {4}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Repeat.

339-1656-5137.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
339-1656-5137.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Jegantha's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

174-2034-2178-5168.notablePrerequisites:
You control a blue, a white, and a black permanent.
Thornbite Staff attached to Bloom Tender.
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
174-2034-2178-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
Worldheart Phoenix dies, triggering Bloom Tender, untapping Bloom Tender.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
